text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains around 1%, suggesting measured buying interest without conviction across the majors. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 70 but has flatlined over a week, indicating sentiment remains elevated yet not accelerating higher. Bitcoin's dominance at 58.8% reflects a slight preference for the largest asset, while the $65B daily volume is moderate, pointing to a market that is active but not in a frenzy.
